details: Bitcoin has climbed towards the $76,000-$77,000 range, supported by significant institutional interest, including over $1 billion in crypto fund inflows and BlackRock's acquisition of 3,352 BTC, bringing its total holdings to 806,000 BTC. Additionally, "Strategy" (likely MicroStrategy) made a massive purchase of 34,164 Bitcoin, pushing its total to over 815,000 BTC. Improving risk sentiment also contributed to the upward momentum.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds to $76K as ETF Inflows and Corporate Buys Drive Optimism

details: The decentralized finance (DeFi) sector is reeling from a $290 million exploit on KelpDAO over the weekend. While the Arbitrum council froze approximately $70-71 million in ETH, the exploiter managed to move another $175 million shortly after. This incident has caused Ethereum and other DeFi tokens to underperform Bitcoin, and Aave's Total Value Locked (TVL) has plunged by 33% to around $16.7 billion.
title: KelpDAO Exploit Hits DeFi, Ethereum Underperforms Amid $290M Loss

details: Bitmine, an Ethereum treasury firm, has made a substantial purchase of 101,627 Ether, marking its largest weekly acquisition of 2026. The company now reports its Ethereum holdings have reached 4.976 million tokens, representing a significant accumulation that signals a positive long-term outlook for ETH.
title: Bitmine Significantly Increases Ethereum Holdings in Largest Weekly Haul

details: The market capitalization for tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) has seen explosive growth, surging 20-fold in the past three years to exceed $29 billion. This trend highlights increasing adoption and investor interest in bringing tangible assets onto blockchain networks.
title: Tokenized Real-World Asset Market Cap Soars to Over $29 Billion

details: Food delivery giant DoorDash is reportedly planning to offer stablecoin payouts to its drivers, partnering with Tempo blockchain. This move represents a significant step towards integrating cryptocurrencies into everyday financial transactions and mainstream adoption.
title: DoorDash Explores Stablecoin Payouts with Tempo for Everyday Crypto Use
